mx.title: Deterministic provenance record for AI-USAGE.pdf

mx.author: Tom Cranstoun
mx.purpose: Let a reader (human, agent, or regulator) walk every rule-driven step behind AI-USAGE.pdf and reproduce its verdicts. An evidence vehicle, not a compliance grant.

fields.Author: Tom Cranstoun
fields.Summary: How AI was used in the writing of the MX book series. Author's declaration on authorship, machine assistance, and the relationship between the two.

artefactMx.note: The XMP-mx fields the artefact carries, from one definition (scripts/lib/pdf/xmp-fields.cjs). SourceSha is stamped into the XMP after the source frontmatter is updated, so it is recorded in each pdf-render step as inputs.sourceSha rather than here; ProvenanceAiPayload embeds this record itself and is never repeated inside it.

_description: Deterministic evidence chain. One entry per rule-driven pipeline step (gate verdict, CSV check, regex match, render step, probe result). It records how the deterministic checks ran (among them the PDF structure check and the per-page automated accessibility results) so they can be reproduced; it cites no regime by default and is not evidence of conformance with any law. Adjacent on disk only; the artefact frontmatter does NOT embed a pointer to this file (the .ai.json companion is the regulator-facing one).
